name: 学校实验室绿幕桌（实测重建）
reconstruction: tape-measured tabletop and robot stand (2026-11-19, data/sim_scene/image); table frame, cable grommet, U-shaped green screen and room by eye from the walk-around video 环境.mp4 (frames in reference/video_*.jpg); robot stand derived from the g1d_v4 URDF chain and meshes (build_scene.py robot_stand, PLAN.md)
scale_basis: tape: tabletop 110 x 60 x 75.8 cm; waist top 48.5 cm over the column base plate; far edge to waist back 81 cm, to waist front 66 cm; waist centre 56.5 cm from the left end; grommet position

table_centre_x_from_robot_root.tool: 卷尺（腰部中线离左端 56.5 cm）

lift_reading_lowest_to_now.tool: 卷尺（腰部盒顶到外立柱顶）

notes: Not measured: chassis yaw (taken square), floor to plate top (URDF chassis assumed), screen distances, table frame sizes. The URDF lift column is ~6 mm taller at zero lift than the real waist height, so lift 0 and root 6 mm low (PLAN.md).
